name: cel-miR-39-3p
note: C. elegans miRNA; no endogenous expression in mammalian samples. Add before lysis/extraction to correct extraction efficiency variation and RT inhibition. [Tan15]

name: miR-16-5p
note: Commonly used reference in tissue/cell lines. AVOID in plasma/serum: elevated by erythrocyte hemolysis — use hemolysis QC (miR-451a/miR-16 ratio) if used in biofluids. [McDonald11]

name: miR-93-5p
note: Reported stable in serum/plasma across several cohort studies. Validate with geNorm/NormFinder in your specific sample type. [Liang18]

name: miR-103a-3p
note: Frequently selected as stable across tissue types by geNorm analysis. Validate with geNorm/NormFinder. [Liang18]

name: miR-191-5p
note: Frequently stable across tissue and cell line panels (Hacimoto 2024). Validate in your cohort. [Hacimoto24]

name: miR-451a
note: Use as hemolysis indicator (ratio miR-451a/miR-16). Highly elevated by erythrocyte contamination. NOT a normalization reference — use as QC control only. [McDonald11]
